name: goal
description: Chantier→spec→plan→autonomous /goal workflow for Claude Code: cut an initiative into an ordered just-in-time backlog (/goal:tickets), settle the functional contract of any source — Jira US (via MCP), GitHub issue, spec file or inline — with a grilled, observable Definition of Done (/goal:spec), lock the executable plan with command-mapped criteria and small functional iterations (/goal:plan), then drive native /goal one iteration at a time with a synthesis at each stop. GitHub, commit and PR are all opt-in, never forced.
